standard_login.details: Login with aaron@stech.com.au / Lucky@2871$! works correctly

rustdesk_config_api.details: GET /api/rustdesk/config returns config structure with server_url, api_key, relay_server, enabled fields

live_test_connection_api.details: GET /api/rustdesk/live/test-connection returns {connected: bool, message: string, server_url: string, endpoints_available: array}. Gracefully handles unreachable server.

live_peers_api.details: GET /api/rustdesk/live/peers returns {peers: array, count: number, source: string, server_url: string}. Returns 400/502 when server unreachable (expected).

live_sync_api.details: POST /api/rustdesk/live/sync returns {message: string, synced: number, created: number, updated: number}. Returns 400/502 when server unreachable (expected).

live_audit_api.details: GET /api/rustdesk/live/audit returns {logs: array, count: number, source: string}. Returns empty logs when server unreachable.

rustdesk_all_devices_api.details: GET /api/rustdesk/all-devices returns list of devices with RustDesk registration status

rustdesk_sessions_api.details: GET /api/rustdesk/sessions returns list of remote sessions

agent_deployments_api.details: GET /api/rustdesk/agent-deployments returns {total, pending, deployed, failed, deployments}
